title: ChatGPT will test visual ads during image generation
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT is adding picture ads while images are being made
summary: OpenAI will begin testing clearly labelled visual ads while ChatGPT generates images, starting later this month with a group of US advertisers. It is also adding conversion-data integrations, attribution partners and brand-suitability pilots, while saying ads will remain separate from generated images and will not influence answers.
friendlySummary: OpenAI will test labelled ads on the screen while ChatGPT creates an image. The first test starts in the United States, and OpenAI says the ads will not change ChatGPT’s answers.
whyItMatters: Advertising is becoming part of the everyday ChatGPT experience and a new customer-discovery channel for businesses. Users should watch how clearly commercial material is separated from assistance, while marketers now have a conversational platform to evaluate alongside search and social media.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People may see more commercial content inside AI tools. Businesses also get a new place to reach customers, so clear labels and privacy protections will matter.
